Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: ACT VII — THE CINDER ARCHIVE. Fleet Log: the Ember Relay holds station. The Beacon's second layer carried Severant command glyphs.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, I have traced the glyphs to a Precursor archive world of ash and glass: the Cinder Archive. The Severants hold it.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: And they are dying. The harmonic the Beacon resumed when we answered it is burning them out from the inside. They call it the Silence.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: The ingredients for a cure are in Vault Alpha. Seeds and Bio-Gel, on the far side of the Arch. Outpost One can ship them, if we choose how.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: We caused this, Captain. Without knowing. That does not make it less ours.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Ashfall Verge. Ash storms around a dead Severant convoy. Leaps out of this storm will cost more unless Lyra charts them.

Lines.Speaker: ArisThorne
Lines.Text: I have my sample from the convoy. The Silence is exactly what I feared. Get me Agrarian Seed stock and one leap of lab time.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Glass Sea: a vitrified ocean world. The storm here is as bad as the Verge.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: This is a weaving place, Captain. If we build a lane, it starts here.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Tether Point. A quiet gravity well between superclusters. Outpost One has a message waiting.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Cinder Archive orbit. The planet is ash over glass. Two Severant transmissions, Captain, at once.

Lines.Speaker: ExarchIthane
Lines.Text: Key-Bearer. You answered what should never have been answered. Silence the Beacon, and surrender yourself to our judgment.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: I am Kesh, Warden of the Quiet Hollow. My people are dying of what you woke. Help us, and I will open the way to the Archive.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Quiet Hollow: Warden Kesh's refuge, inside a hollowed moon.

Lines.Speaker: WardenKesh
Lines.Text: Our doors open to friends, Key-Bearer. I hope you are one.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Pyre Gate. Exarch Ithane's fortress over the Archive's poles.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The outer marker of Tithe Anchorage. Commander Vance's forward picket holds here.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Vault of Records: the Archive core. It opens only past the Pyre Gate.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Key-Bearer. There is a part of me here. I would like it back.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: Captain, the pursuit clock ran out. Iron Tithe drive signatures on top of us.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: You left a wake a child could follow, Key-Bearer.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Commander Vance's ambush group has withdrawn. Pursuit is clear for now.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Choir-skiffs are destroyed or routed.

Lines.Speaker: Lyra
Lines.Text: I would rather we had talked.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Bastion core is down. The Pyre Gate is open.

Lines.Speaker: TalaVane
Lines.Text: The Vault is through there.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The grafted frigate is destroyed.

Lines.Speaker: CommanderVance
Lines.Text: Ithane's gift. Every ship I own will carry one before we meet again.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The Vault is quiet. Commander Vance is withdrawing toward Tithe Anchorage.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The record: the Answerers built the Omega Arch and the Architect to carry the reply. The Severants sealed Gate Zero and split its keys among the Synod, the Guild and the Coalition.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The Answerers' last warships were stasis-locked in the Event Horizon Forge before the Severants could destroy them: the two hundred ships of the Phantom Fleet.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I locked them to protect them, and stayed at the Arch to guard whoever came. I kept them for you, Key-Bearer. I did not know it was you I was keeping them for.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The record ends on the Listener's first message, which no Precursor could translate. It is not a call for help, Captain. Nor a threat. It is a question.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The record: the Answerers built the Omega Arch and the Architect to carry the reply. The Severants sealed Gate Zero and split its keys among the Synod, the Guild and the Coalition.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The Answerers' last warships were stasis-locked in the Event Horizon Forge: the two hundred ships of the Phantom Fleet. The Automated Fleet Key routes through the Architect's own core.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: I unlocked them for you. I can unlock them for anyone.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: Captain, that means it can take them back.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The record ends on the Listener's first message, which no Precursor could translate. It is not a call for help. Nor a threat. It is a question.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The record: the Answerers built the Omega Arch and the Architect to carry the reply. The Severants sealed Gate Zero and split its keys among the Synod, the Guild and the Coalition.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Who locked the Phantom Fleet in the Event Horizon Forge, and why, is damaged exactly where it would answer.

Lines.Speaker: CoreArchitect
Lines.Text: Ask me again when you know what you want me to be.

Lines.Speaker: VexAI
Lines.Text: The record ends on the Listener's first message, which no Precursor could translate. It is not a call for help, Captain. Nor a threat. It is a question.
